messages:
elaine-r: FYI customers reporting SSO fail + mass SCIM deprovs after yesterday's RBAC enforcement change. Quick glance: auth-proxy logs show binding mismatch and audit-shipper shows a small flush gap.

matt-b: Example auth-proxy snippet:
```
WARN  auth-proxy: saml: binding mismatch expected=HTTP-POST got=HTTP-Artifact tenant=zenith
INFO  scim-worker: enqueue deprov tenant=zenith svc_acc=sa-ml cause=auth_failed
```

omar-s: I also saw audit-shipper restarted during the same window. Some service_account.role updates missing in audit-db. grep shows restart at 1705551100 with SIGTERM.

elaine-r: Hypothesis: IdP metadata for some tenants moved to Artifact-only and our RBAC change flipped the proxy to reject Artifact. Also small audit shipper restart lost a handful of events. Plan: (1) enable tenant-gated artifact fallback in auth-proxy, (2) requeue deprovs for impacted tenants, (3) backfill audit events, (4) check KMS token-wrap aliases for stale refs.

matt-b: I'll open a minimal PR to add config flag `saml.allowArtifactFallback` and a tenant whitelist. Will canary to infra-canary after tests.

omar-s: I'll run backfill and requeue scripts: `./scripts/backfill-audit.sh --start 1705550800 --end 1705551400 --verify` and `./scripts/requeue-deprov.sh --tenant zenith --since 1705550800`. Also checking redis for token:wrap-key alias.

oncall: Incident ticket created INC-2025-042. Running mitigations and coordinating customer comms. sso-bot: deploy queued for canary.

elaine-r: Owners: Matt=auth-proxy patch, Omar=backfill & KMS check, Elaine=postmortem & customer note. Will follow up here when canary passes. :thumbsup:
